scope.description: Statewide baseline for Nevada public-meeting acquisition. Covers every county or county-equivalent government, incorporated city, county school district, and the primary statewide meeting layers.
scope.unincorporatedCommunityPolicy: County meeting coverage is inherited until a separate town board or special district source is registered.
